name: newsletter-sender
description: Newsletters for solo writers, businesses and agencies, from your own Cloudflare account. Hosted on Cloudflare, sent with Amazon SES.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long secret code you choose (replace the example, which won't work). After deploying, open `https://<your Newsletter Sender>/setup?code=<your code>` to make your account. Only someone with the code can.
